worldcombat.skill.defendorder.summary: Calls a squad of underlings onto its body to form a living shell: each one alive gives +1 Defense and +1 Sp. Def, and each one killed thins the shell at once. The only member of its group whose benefit rides on living bodies — the foe can shoot the underlings off first. Swarm style has more, higher ceiling and frailer bugs; elite style has fewer, sturdier ones.
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.use.0: Call a squad onto the body and stack both defenses
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.use.1: Make the foe clear the bugs before it can reach you
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.use.2: Lay down a breakable shield in a close-range trade
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.descriptio: Calls %1$s underlings onto the body; each one alive raises Defense and Sp. Def by %2$s stage.
The underlings stay about %1$s, cling %2$s blocks out, and each has %3$s health.
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.swarm.on: Swarm: +2 underlings and a higher ceiling, but each has 3 health and can be wiped in one sweep.
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.swarm.off: Elite: each has 6 health and the shell holds longer, at the cost of fewer bodies and a lower ceiling.
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.growth.0: At level %1$s the cling lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.growth.1: At level %1$s the cling reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.preference: On: +2 underlings and a higher ceiling, but each has 3 health and can be wiped in one sweep. Off: elite, each has 6 health and the shell holds longer, at the cost of fewer bodies and a lower ceiling.
Consider calling underlings when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of calling; larger gives up the shell more often up close.
Below this health ratio the companion calls underlings before the shared order; larger enters the defensive stance sooner, smaller only when nearly down.
worldcombat.skill.defendorder.descriptio: The underlings are attackable targets: each one killed withdraws its stage at once, and once all are cleared the shell grants nothing more. Only one shell is kept at a time and it cannot be recast until it disperses; when its time runs out or it is cleared, the underlings scatter together and every stage is withdrawn.
